description: This file defines the BooleanDatatype class, a custom datatype for handling boolean values within the OpenMRS platform. It provides serialization and deserialization methods for Boolean objects.

classes.name: BooleanDatatype
classes.description: A custom datatype class for boolean values, extending SerializingCustomDatatype with methods for serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts a Boolean object to its string representation for storage.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts a string representation back to a Boolean object.
